article_facts: fact:location: Mugwort's Hollow is a timed instance where Forest Snakes and Battle Warthogs yield life magic samples; the bonus objective is completing it in under 10 minutes. | completing the area in less than 10 minutes (http://www.tentonhammer.com:80/node/69770)
